svg.aria-label: npm Publish, Pipesmith Registry 0.2.0. npm login trades the password for a token once; every publish sends it as Bearer and writes two blobs. 1: npm client to Server: PUT /-/user/org.couchdb.user:<name> {name, password}. 2: Server to Realms: check the pair. 3: Server to state.sqlite: row: SHA-256 of the secret half, at most 20 per user. 4: Server to npm client: 201 {token: NpmToken.<11>.<43>}. 5: npm client: keeps the token as _authToken. Publish. 6: npm client to Server: PUT /<package>, Authorization: Bearer, tarball attached. 7: Server to state.sqlite: token digest compared, user read now. 8: Server to local-write: tarball <package>/-/<name>-<version>.tgz. 9: Server to local-write: merged document <package>, new _rev. 10: Server to index.sqlite: two rows, before the answer. 11: Server to npm client: 201 {ok, id, rev}.
svg.title: Pipesmith Registry npm publish
